content:
To avoid being overshadowed by the new Mac mini and Mac Studio, Apple today also launched an updated polishing cloth. In an era where everything is getting more expensive, the new polishing cloth goes against the grain, with its price reduced from the previous US$19 to US$9.

It is currently unknown what changes have been made to the new polishing cloth. Apple's product description for the new version is identical to the old one:

Apple launched the polishing cloth in October 2021, and it sold out almost instantly. Although this product has become an internet meme, it is indeed a high-quality polishing cloth suitable for Apple products.

You can order this "new" polishing cloth for US$9 on Apple's official website today. I'm telling you to act fast, and I'm not joking, because it will very likely sell out again.

If you want to collect a piece of Apple history, the old polishing cloth is still available on Amazon for US$19.
